lblFile: Which chart is on show and how many there are. Tap it for the next one: the airport diagram, the parking charts, then the airport's instrument charts from the app.
btnAgc: The airport diagram, drawn from Falcon BMS's own airfield data: runways, taxiways, ramp and buildings (Deck on a carrier). Hidden while it is on show.
btnApc1: A parking chart: the ramp as BMS numbers its spots when this runway is in use (it numbers them again for each runway end). Where BMS has no ground chart, an instrument chart.

cntChart: The chart on show. A drawn chart (airport diagram, parking) is turned to fill the box, its north arrow saying which way; the wheel, two fingers or a drag zoom and pan it.
